final_message:
I saved a revision checklist on your bus essay. Dr. Weiss allows AI help with planning and asks you to write the essay wording yourself.

After work, start with the position you already have in your conclusion. Bring the one-year fare-free trial on routes 14 and 22 into your opening and explain why you favor it. Then spend most of your time on two questions: How could the city pay for the trial? What source shows how much ridership changed in Riverton? Developing those answers will help bring your 391-word draft closer to the 1,000-word target.

The checklist covers all nine comments and budgets about an hour and 45 minutes, including proofreading. Starting at nine would leave you over an hour before the 11:59 p.m. submission deadline.

detail.text: 10 min · Start with your proposal. In paragraph 1, bring forward the one-year trial on routes 14 and 22 that you propose in paragraph 5. Give your strongest reason for it. Use the conclusion to explain what the council should look for at the end of the trial.
